human_summary: A road accident in Tongi, Gazipur resulted in the death of a 15-year-old madrasa student, Yasin Ali, as reported by regional sources [ev_25f22aa562f7533f, ev_33738fa816ada880]. The incident drew student protests that blocked the Dhaka-Mymensingh highway for about three hours, causing severe traffic congestion lasting roughly 15 kilometers and affecting thousands of passengers [ev_25f22aa562f7533f]. The sources agree on the location and the single fatality, but the identity of the victim and his age are mentioned only in the web articles, while the video analysis simply states a student was killed. The exact time of the crash remains unknown; the reports indicate a protest period, but no precise crash time. A bus is mentioned as one of the vehicles involved in one source, but this is not corroborated elsewhere. The independent source count is low: two separate sources, though the articles may be from the same publisher. The traffic congestion and protest are treated as later developments of the event. The most significant unresolved uncertainty is the precise crash time and the details of the collision, including whether other vehicles were involved.
